purpose: Development-only policy-versus-mixed candidate opportunity and forecast support; no scorer or gate
perturbation: Two seeded unit translation directions, plus/minus each, fixed sin-squared envelope, preserve gripper, clip[-1,1]
identity: Deduplicate byte-identical clipped full actions; execute each unique proposal once per repeat; both banks reference the same unique outcomes and forecasts
outcome: Ever-success under frozen matched-seed continuation; stop at success, termination, truncation or absolute episode step400
sampling: Complete fixed task x seed grids, every reached declared decision, retain ties/failures/duplicates; no outcome-based sampling or progression
language: Record instruction text; no new learned instruction embedding is used by this collector
analysis: Trace-first paired bank comparisons; full-state fixed controls, helpful/harmful/tied opportunity, effective uniqueness/saturation, forecast/persistence and support; separate pilot/main and offline complete-future subset; no model selection or closed-loop claim
